name: Stormbringer: Unbound Elementalist strengthens Unshackle by 20% (#2807)

steps.label: SETUP: the Air Elemental Unshackle buffs is present
BASELINE: no all-effects modifier applies to Unshackle without the passive
BASELINE: Unshackle's damage effect is its own 25% (EffectBasePoints[1] 24 + EffectDieSides[1] 1)
BASELINE: Unshackle's haste effect is its own 30% (EffectBasePoints[2] 29 + EffectDieSides[2] 1)
BASELINE: the applied pet aura carries the unmodified 25%
DISCRIMINATING: Unbound Elementalist applies its tooltip's 20% to Unshackle as a caster-side all-effects modifier
DISCRIMINATING: the strengthened value reaches the aura applied to the Air Elemental

contract: #2807: Unbound Elementalist rank 1 (705702) reads "Increases the effectiveness of your Unshackle by $s2%", and $s2 quotes its Effect[1] amount, 20 (EffectBasePoints[1] 19 + EffectDieSides[1] 1). Both of its SPELL_AURA_ADD_PCT_MODIFIER effects use EffectMiscValue 8 (SPELLMOD_ALL_EFFECTS) and class mask {16,0,0}, which addresses Unshackle (706625) and, per a full Spell.dbc scan of SpellFamilyName 22, nothing else. The caster-side Effect[0] ships with EffectBasePoints -1 + EffectDieSides 1 = 0 while the 20 sits on the pet-targeted Effect[1], and spell modifiers are ignored on non-players, so the shipped record delivers nothing. Unshackle's own effects are 25% damage and 30% haste, which the modifier raises to 30 and 36. Rank 2 (705703) is not obtainable and is not exercised here.
